scientific.finding: For the real Hölder-dual planes \(\ell_3^2\) and \(\ell_{3/2}^2\), the optimal global Dragomir-symmetry parameter is \(\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{27}{17+7\sqrt7}\right)^{2/3}}\).
scientific.integrity: The global optimization is proved analytically from the functional characterization of Dragomir approximate Birkhoff-James orthogonality. Numerical code is used only for algebraic and finite-grid consistency checks.
scientific.limitations: Real two-dimensional spaces only; the exact formula is proved only for the Hölder-conjugate exponents \(p=3\) and \(p=3/2\). No general-\(p\), higher-dimensional, or complex-scalar formula is claimed.

title: Exact Dragomir-symmetry constant for the Hölder-dual planes \(\ell_3^2\) and \(\ell_{3/2}^2\)
